info.title: Rocket.Surgery.ApiReference
info.description: Generates the JSON that the docs sites render their C# API reference from, using the build output of a solution.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Generates the JSON the docs sites render their C# API reference from, out of a solution's build output.

options.name: --solution
options.description: The solution (.sln or .slnx) whose packable projects to document. It must already be built.

options.name: --configuration
options.description: The build configuration to read the assemblies from. [default: Release]

options.name: --framework
options.description: The target framework to document. Projects that don't target it use their newest platform-neutral one. [default: net10.0]

options.name: --output
options.description: The directory to write one <PackageId>.json per package to. JSON files for packages that no longer exist are removed.

options.name: --source-root
options.description: The checkout root that source paths are made relative to. Defaults to the solution's directory.
